title: Pre-bill Dry-run Adjudicator: simulated billing sandbox and differential detector
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a pre-bill dry-run adjudication pipeline that simulates month-end invoices in a sandbox environment, computes per-tenant charge deltas versus the canonical billing ledger, surfaces high-confidence discrepancies, and emits reviewable adjustment proposals. The goal is to detect regressions in token accounting and attribution before they affect customer invoices and to provide deterministic, explainable diffs operators can act on.
background: Recent incidents and late-arrival token corrections have led to customer support escalations and post-bill adjustments. We currently run end-of-day reconciliations but lack a fast, deterministic simulation that can run candidate billing pipeline changes and quantify their invoice delta across representative tenants. This ticket creates a reusable pre-bill sandbox runner and a differential adjudicator (diff engine + scoring) that integrates with the consumption ledger and the proposed correction workflow.
goals: Provide a sandbox dry-run that mirrors production ledger ingest logic but is hermetic and idempotent
Implement a diff engine that groups deltas by tenant, invoice line, and attribution source with root-cause tags
Score discrepancies by confidence and dollar/token impact and produce reviewable adjustment records
Add observability (per-tenant delta histogram, top-k root causes) and automated alerts for high-risk regressions
Make the system usable by PM/finance to run scenario comparisons for rollouts and config changes
non_goals: Automatic auto-apply of adjustments without human review
Replacing the canonical ledger; this is a simulation and advisory system
architecture_summary: Pipeline stages: 1) sandbox ingest that replays production events into a quarantined state store; 2) deterministic billing runner that computes token usage and cost using the same pricing functions; 3) diff engine that compares dry-run charges to canonical ledger snapshots; 4) adjudicator that groups deltas, applies heuristics to tag root causes (late-arrival, attribution-merge, quantization change), and emits proposed_adjustments records for manual review. All stages support idempotent runs and have optional sampling knobs for scale.
implementation_notes: Sandbox state will use a namespaced ledger prefix and be backed by existing sharded event store (read-only in prod) to avoid schema drift
Leverage the runtime's pricing library (billing-pricer v2) directly to ensure parity; add compatibility tests
Diff engine implemented as streaming join keyed by session_id -> produce aggregated delta records; use bloom filters to skip unchanged tenants
Adjudicator will compute a confidence score from signal features: late_event_rate, attribution_mismatch_score, token_bucket_penalty, and cross-route_overlap_pct
Expose a dry-run API endpoint for PM/finance to launch scenarios with params (date-range, tenant set, pricing override)
acceptance_criteria: Can run a full dry-run for a 3-day window for 1k representative tenants within 2 hours on staging infra
Diff results align with production ledger for a canonical golden sample (<=0.1% token delta) when config is identical
Top-10 deltas include root-cause tags and human-readable explanation strings
Proposed adjustments records are written to proposed_adjustments table and surfaced in console review UI
Automated alert triggers when median per-tenant invoice delta exceeds $500 or >5% tenants have >2% delta
test_plan: Unit tests for pricing parity against billing-pricer v2 using snapshot fixtures
Integration test: run dry-run against a replay of last-month events and compare diffs to production adjustments (golden ledger)
Canary: enable shadow-run for 1% of tenants in staging, validate no writes to production ledger
Chaos test: inject late-arrival events and verify adjudicator tags and confidence scoring
Load test: verify pipeline scales to 10k tenants/day on current staging cluster
rollout_plan: Phase 1: internal staging runs for engineering and finance (no UI) — 1 week
Phase 2: enable console dry-run API and review UI for ops and PMs (shadow-only) — 2 weeks
Phase 3: expand to scheduled month-end simulations and integrate with release gating for billing-related runtime changes
Fallback: immediate rollback to scheduled-only mode if median delta alert fires repeatedly
monitoring_and_observability: Dashboards: pre-bill overview + top root-cause table with links to tenant-level traces
Logs: structured diff records stored in s3 with partitioning by run_id for forensic queries
Alerts: Pager duty for P0 threshold breaches and Slack #billing-alerts for medium thresholds
migration_notes: No immediate migration required. Proposed adjustments are staged in a separate table and require manual approval before any production ledger writes. When enabling an auto-apply mode in future, we will add incremental backfills and a reconciliation window to avoid double-crediting.
security_considerations: Dry-run data contains PII-equivalent tenant IDs; runs must respect VPC access controls and KMS encryption at rest
UI must enforce RBAC so only finance/ops can view proposed adjustments
Ensure sandbox writes cannot accidentally be promoted into production ledger by namespacing and CI gates
